b8ce33feb1db.en: Which carbon data does I-Cost use?

0990b488c1c3.en: A carbon library of UK Government material factors and ÖKOBAUDAT datasets (to EN 15804+A2), plus your own EPD or company figures, per estimate line. Match with AI only matches your lines to materials in that library; it never supplies carbon figures.

1d8665fe6990.en: Does I-Cost use AI for carbon?

3a21c5ea6dcb.en: Only to match, when you press the button. Match with AI (Claude, by Anthropic) suggests which material in the carbon library fits each estimate line; the carbon figure always comes from the library, never from the AI. For products the library lacks, Build up the rest estimates which library materials one unit is made of, marked as estimated, and nothing is added until you press Use. Only line descriptions, units and section names are sent: no prices, quantities or personal details, and they are not used to train the AI.

4a6d513b8419.en: Is the whole life carbon assessment RICS compliant?

a5f79deb2883.en: It follows the RICS Professional Standard for whole life carbon assessment (2nd edition) and BS EN 15978 life-cycle stages. It is in beta, and formal submissions should still be reviewed by a qualified assessor.
